answer: Fabricating sybils means locking real capital per fake account plus risking the endorser's velvet reputation, so a cheap swarm becomes expensive fast. Each agent stakes a bond into a shared vault, and every new identity must be endorsed through a trust thread linking it to a verified peer. The vault slashes bonds when duplicate behavior surfaces, making mass identity creation costlier than legitimate work. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
